subject: Greentech tenant access bridge and API welcome plan
messages:
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: kaya.harper@aishaconsult.com, itops@greentech.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 18 Apr 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Greentech tenant access bridge and API welcome plan

Hi Kaya / Greentech team —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Per our conversation, this thread is the operational kickoff for tenant activation and the initial access bridge: we’ll provide a short-term API key and a seeded project so your devs can run smoke tests while we finish secure key rotation and role mapping. High-level plan below, and I’ve attached a one-page checklist for your records.

1) Short-term access: temporary API key & seeded project (valid 72h) — we’ll drop the stub and rotate to your customer-managed KMS when you’re ready.
2) Admin seats: we’ll provision two workspace admins (Samir, Kaya) and one billing contact.
3) Roles and scopes: suggested roles attached — we recommend conservative default scopes for first 2 weeks.
4) Integration tests: simple generation + embedding smoke tests — see sample curl and Postman link in Drive.
5) Handoff: Monica (CS) will lead delivery; Ben (Onboarding ENG) will do the key rotation and project config.

Action items for Greentech: please confirm the admin emails you want seeded and the preferred window for key rotation (we recommend Fri 4/19 09:00-11:00 PT).

Attachments: greentech-init-checklist.pdf (plan + role matrix).

Thanks — looking forward to launching this with you.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber | Account Manager, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: kaya.harper@aishaconsult.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: samir.desai@greentech.com
Date: Thu, 18 Apr 2029 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Greentech tenant access bridge and API welcome plan

Thanks Jonas — this looks good. Quick clarifications from our side: 

- Confirmed admins: samir.desai@greentech.com, kaya.harper@aishaconsult.com (Kaya is implementing on behalf of Greentech).
- Billing contact: finance@greentech.com (please leave out of admin scopes).
- Preferred window: Friday 4/19 09:00 PT works. If possible, can you schedule the temporary key earlier on Friday so our CI pipeline can run in the morning?

We also need a short list of the API endpoints we should allow in the firewall for the first smoke tests (we’re behind a strict outbound proxy).

—Kaya
Kaya Harper | Principal Engineer, Aisha Consulting (impl. partner)
kaya.harper@aishaconsult.com

From: monica_patel@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 18 Apr 2029 11:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Greentech tenant access bridge and API welcome plan — internal ops notes

FYI internal ops notes before I reply to Kaya: 

- Temporary key: I’ll mint a time-limited token and upload a small stub to the thread once done (include in attachments). Ben — can you pre-seed the dev project "greentech-dev-1" with the sample prompts and embedding dataset? We’ll keep the project public-to-tenant only.
- Firewall list for proxy: allow endpoints: api-inference.redwood.com/v1/generate, /v1/embeddings, /v1/health. Also open ports 443 outbound. Include the Postman collection link.
- Rotation plan: Ben will perform KMS handoff Fri 9:00-9:30 PT; Monica to validate token revocation after rotation.

Ben — please confirm you can seed by 08:30 PT Friday so Kaya can run CI at 08:45. If not, propose fallback times.

—Monica
Monica Patel | Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

From: ben_carter@redwood.com

Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 19 Apr 2029 07:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Greentech tenant access bridge and API welcome plan — temp key and seed complete

Monica / Jonas / Kaya —

Completed the prep work this morning: 

- Seeded project: greentech-dev-1 (sample prompts, small corpus, embedding index).
- Temporary API key: greentech-temp-72h-XYZ (attached as temp-api-key-stub.txt). Key is valid from 2029-04-19T08:00:00-07:00 to 2029-04-22T08:00:00-07:00.
- Firewalls: allowed endpoints confirmed — api-inference.redwood.com/v1/generate, /v1/embeddings, /v1/health.
- Postman collection: https://drive.redwood/company/greentech/postman-collection (test suite + curl examples).

Kaya — try CI at 08:45 PT. I will stand by on the rotation at 09:00 PT and will run the KMS handoff as planned; Monica, I’ll send the rotation audit when complete.

Attachments: temp-api-key-stub.txt, greentech-mrp-schedule.xlsx.

—Ben
Ben Carter | Onboarding Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
